entries.name: Bachelor of Criminal Justice
entries.reason: No standalone 'Bachelor of Criminal Justice' course exists in CSU's current course-finder catalogue or handbook. The only course carrying 'Criminal Justice' in its title is the combined double degree 'Bachelor of Laws / Bachelor of Criminal Justice' (course code 2418LC01), which CSU's own live course-finder API (study.csu.edu.au course-finder-var.js) flags with meta_status "suspended-all" (closed to all new enrolments). Bachelor of Criminology (course code 1415CJ01) is the live current standalone award in this subject area.
